title: relay@1
description: The relay protocol (#309; canvas primitives: Net: relay protocol relay@1): a copy's connection to the relay it was given, a WebSocket over https. Each control message is one JSON text message holding exactly one of these members; each frame is one binary message laid out as x-frame says, forwarded to the other copies of the sender's match only. The relay's first message is its hello; a copy refuses a relay whose hello names another protocol or digest before it sends any frame. A new shape is relay@2, never a change here.

hello.description: The relay's first message: the protocol, its digest and the limits per connection.

join.description: A copy joins a match by its ID; open is true only from the copy that drew the ID, and a second opening join of a held match joins it.

joined.description: The relay's answer to a join it seated.

refused.description: The relay's answer to a join it refused: no open match by that ID, every seat taken before the match's first frame, or after it.

start.description: To every copy of a match once its last seat is taken; no copy sends a frame before it.

closed.description: To a match's other copies when a copy's connection ends: it left, or the relay closed it for passing frames_per_s in each of 3 seconds running or for one frame past frame_bytes.

signal.description: Only to set up a direct path: a copy names the player it is for (to) and the relay hands it on naming the sender (from).

x-frame.confirmed: the lowest step this copy holds every player's entries for
x-frame.first: the frame's first step; each frame repeats its copy's steps after the lowest step every peer confirmed
